notes: Rebuilt 2026-11-23 by run_stpaul.py (replaces st_paul.ipynb). Source: the City of Saint Paul's city-only copy of Ramsey County's Attributed Tax Parcels (PAULIE/FeatureServer/1, edited 2026-11-19): 2026 assessment, taxes payable 2027, estimated market value. The previous build carried 2024 values and divided each condo unit's value by its own ParcelSquareFeet, which made the tall needles.

Condo, condo-garage, co-op and TICO-townhome units are each mapped as a copy of the lot polygon (453 stacks, up to 594 deep); every stack is collapsed to one parcel with values summed, and every per-sqft rate uses the polygon's geodesic area.

Ramsey County gives condo units nominal land (~$1,000 each). For 340 merged condo developments, land is ESTIMATED from the 15 nearest non-condo parcels (lot area x their median land $/sqft, capped at 70% of value; total value unchanged), flagged condo_land_imputed = 1 with the assessor figure in assessor_land_value (+$101.6M land). run_stpaul.py --no-condo-impute ships the assessor figure.

Five 'economic units' are merged: a built parcel carrying a whole development's land (> $50/sqft and > 5x its same-owner building-less neighbours) is unioned with those pieces, e.g. 1845 University Ave W ($736/sqft -> $39.73/sqft).

Exempt (TaxExemptYN = Y or 6xx code, 3,422 parcels, $2.32B land) and railroad/utility operating property (8xx/900) dropped. 72,429 parcels, land $7.11B, improvements $29.28B. PMTiles + H3, --drop-remnants.
Parking (2026-06-02) was built against the previous parcel file and has not been regenerated.
